title: mytherapio App UI Design
subtitle: UI/UX Design, Mobile App Design
description: I designed the user interfaces for mytherapio's two apps—a Client App for the public and a Partner App for admins—in Figma. The goal was to create a calm, trustworthy, and professional experience that stays consistent across both apps, guiding clients smoothly through therapy and legal advice services while giving partners a clear, efficient interface for managing their work.
